name: SEC EDGAR XBRL CompanyFacts
terms: SEC fair-access policy; identify user agent, maximum 10 requests/s
reuse: Link API; any public derived file requires field/date and rights review
use: Financial statement ratios, ICFR/CapEx, audit-risk ex-ante measures
pilot_evidence: Portfolio ICFR/CAM/CapEx concepts; per-firm reproducibility pending
caveat: CompanyFacts contains standardized facts, not complete CAM, KAM, or narrative text.

name: SEC EDGAR filings / 10-K / 10-Q
terms: SEC fair-access policy; per-filing provenance, acceptance and public availability dates
reuse: Link original filings; new text datasets only after extraction/provenance and legal review
use: Risk factors, auditor report, CAM narrative, internal controls, AI spending disclosure
pilot_evidence: CAM/ICFR and financial text source plan
caveat: Do not use 2026 disclosures as features for an earlier fiscal-year prediction.

name: SEC Financial Statement Data Sets
terms: SEC filing-derived; quality caveats and filing precedence
reuse: Source link + verified code/small independently prepared examples
use: Panel accounting facts and reconciliation to XBRL
pilot_evidence: Supporting SEC/XBRL replication; no independent full panel audit here
caveat: Not a substitute for the original company filing.

name: Analytext financial textual repository
terms: Website states CC BY-NC 4.0; noncommercial, attribution; some Python source code available to purchase
reuse: External-link first; check CC BY-NC 4.0 and file-specific terms; never assume paid extraction code is free
use: 10-K/10-Q notes and sections, 32 accounting topics, human capital/footnote metrics
pilot_evidence: Drive has Analytext/TextBlocks folders; actual pilot-file audit not completed
caveat: Noncommercial access is not the same as permission to relicense material as CC0/MIT.

name: Loughran–McDonald Master Dictionary
terms: Academic noncommercial use; commercial licence via authors; cite original work
reuse: External-link first; request separate commercial licence where applicable
use: Financial tone, negative words, uncertainty, litigiousness, complexity/reproducible lexicons
pilot_evidence: Multiple master dictionary 1993–2025 files located in user's Drive; version/duplication audit pending
caveat: Versioned 2026 source includes MasterDictionary_1993-2025; do not mix with 1993–2021 silently.

name: SRAF textual analysis resources
terms: Noncommercial research on 'as is' basis; sources may carry different terms
reuse: Links/code metadata first; assess each resource separately
use: Financial NLP preprocessing, dictionary methods, stopwords and code
pilot_evidence: Source registry reference in CAM/KAM/AI NLP research

name: Kenneth French Data Library
terms: Factors constructed from licensed upstream data; method changed from CRSP FIZ to CIZ for 2025 releases
reuse: Link original factor files; verify redistribution rights for CRSP-derived inputs before mirroring
use: Fama–French 3/5 factor, industry peers, momentum and asset-pricing benchmarks
pilot_evidence: 3-company pilot MSFT/WMT/JPM executed using Ken French factors plus IEX/Alpaca pricing
caveat: Public factor data do not grant redistribution rights to raw CRSP, IEX or other price feeds.

name: Aswath Damodaran valuation and industry data
terms: Third-party company-level restrictions; source data and vintage should be recorded
reuse: Link published industry aggregates; company-level vendor-derived data not for republication
use: Valuation, cost of capital, industry beta, capex/FCF benchmarks and risk premia
pilot_evidence: 10-firm CapEx pilot uses 30 exploratory observations (FY2023–2025), transcribed from StockAnalysis, not validated AI-specific CapEx
caveat: Do not represent Damodaran methodology as a source for these manually transcribed firm-level cash flows.

name: PCAOB public firm inspection reports
terms: Only public report portions and correct unit of analysis
reuse: Link to report and official public structured files; source-level rights check before mirror
use: Audit firm inspections, auditor oversight and quality signals
pilot_evidence: PC/PCAOB part of research roadmap; issuer-level outcomes not automatically identifiable
caveat: Do not invent firm-issuer match or treat inspection deficiency as issuer restatement.

name: SEC Accounting & Auditing Enforcement Releases
terms: Not an exhaustive universe of all misconduct cases
reuse: Link to original enforcement orders; independently label outcomes and as-of dates
use: Forensic accounting, future reporting enforcement, independent outcomes
pilot_evidence: User project benchmark includes AAER; full evidence outcome mapping not validated
caveat: A filed/settled action is not a blanket issuer-year fraud label.

name: World Development Indicators
terms: WDI CC BY 4.0 (some third-party data exceptions); proper attribution required
reuse: Candidate for a verified CC BY 4.0 credited extract; check each indicator's specific terms
use: Macroeconomic control variables in risk, valuation and sustainable investment
pilot_evidence: Potential macro controls, not a verified input in every pilot
caveat: Do not use current-year macro values as known historical predictors if released later.
